fields.Name: Scheduled Job
fields.Description: Sent when a scheduled job (MJ: Scheduled Jobs) finishes and the job's NotifyOnSuccess/NotifyOnFailure toggles ask for it — delivered to the job's NotifyUser, or its owner when none is set. The job's own NotifyViaEmail/NotifyViaInApp toggles act as a ceiling on the channels resolved here, so a recipient can decline a channel the job asked for but the job can never add one it did not.
